text:
maria: Quick question — where's the canonical Grafana dashboard for per-model latency? Need p50/p95/p99 for hosted-api and TTFT (time-to-first-token) and tokens/sec metrics for a customer call in 30 min.

kevin: There's a 'Serving -> Latency' dashboard. Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abcd123/serving-latency?orgId=1 — panels for p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/sec, kv cache.

sanjay: Also check the Tempo traces for slow requests. For TTFT specifically, look for the panel named first_token_time_ms (it uses the first_token_time histogram from the runtime).

observability-bot: FYI: Dashboard slug is serving-latency, panels: p50, p95, p99, ttft, tokens_per_sec. Active alert: latency-high-p95 -> fires on p95 > 300ms for last 5m.

olga: If you want PromQL for p95 by model (5m):
```
sum by(model) (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)))
```
Use the model variable at the top to scope.

jack: Heads-up: the hosted-api panels aggregate by model_family by default. Change the drop-down var "model" to the specific model name to see per-model curves.

maria: Thanks — where do we find traces for a single request id? Customer sent request-id: req_9f8a

kevin: Use Tempo: https://traces.redwood.company/explore and filter by tag request_id=req_9f8a. If you prefer logs: https://logs.redwood.company/logs?q=request_id%3D%22req_9f8a%22.

mike: Quick debugging tip: if p99 > ~500ms, often KV cache cold-starts or evictions are to blame. Check kv-cache-hit-rate panel and backend_eviction_count.

lisa: Can someone tweak the latency-high-p95 alert? It's noisy right now because it's firing on warmup requests that are tiny (<10 tokens).

olga: Filed alert tweak ticket #3421. Proposed rule: only fire if tokens_per_req > 30 AND p95 > 300ms over 5m. Added suggested prometheus expr in the ticket. cc @eng-sre

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll push a small change to the alert and add a runbook link to the dashboard (how to triage, quick checks: traces, kv cache, batching metrics). Will ping SRE if it keeps firing after the threshold change.

deploy-bot: deploy: grafana/serving-latency updated by kevin (branch: fix/alert-tuning)

maria: Perfect. Also can you ping @sanjay for a quick CR on the dashboard patch to include tokens_per_req label on the p95 panel?

sanjay: On it. Will review in ~10 minutes and merge if green.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. If this helps the customer, I'll follow up with screenshots during the call.
